decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used on the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional door or window openings shall be provided in the external walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The high level windows in the south west facing elevation of the extension shall be provided in obscure glass only, and shall be retained as such.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to the house
